signal: Monograph continues to scale its practice-management platform across 750+ AEC firms

email.body1:
Brett, saw Monograph now powers project and cost management across 750-plus AEC firms.

At that scale of addressable market, an SDR team's follow-up volume and response speed usually decide how much pipeline you actually capture, and slow first touches are where good-fit firms slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so your reps cover far more without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to Monograph's top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body2:
Brett, quick follow-up for Monograph.

For an SDR team, ramp time and response speed are where the math wins or loses. The teams that scale automate research and first drafts so reps spend their hours in live conversations instead of tab-switching.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Brett, last bit of proof for Monograph.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your SDR team's reply rate likely compares to other vertical SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brett, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up follow-up without adding SDRs is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters, and I know running an SDR team is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR team? I will tailor it to Monograph either way.
